parties.petitioner: State of Uttar Pradesh and Anr.

summary: Pay scale disparity among education department posts; SDI/ABSA and DBSA vs Headmasters; 2001 pay revision granted only to Headmasters; first litigation upheld High Court direction for equal pay scales; government's 2010 Rizvi Committee proposal accepted in principle; subsequent delay-caused dismissal of intra-court appeal set aside; doctrine of merger not applicable where initial order remains unsettled; res judicata not pleaded; restored pay scale 7500-12000 for SDI/ABSA from 2001.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court's dismissal of intra-court appeal set aside; Single Judge's direction for pay scale 7500-12000 to SDI/ABSA and DBSA effective from 2001 restored.
